clinical_intent: During quality assurance testing, the well chamber reading shows a 2% decrease in source strength compared to the previous monthly measurement, which is within normal decay expectations. However, the physicist notes that the temperature and pressure corrections were not applied to the current reading. Recalculate the corrected source strength and evaluate whether the reading is consistent with expected decay.
